summary: Complete frontend testing of PixelVue product pages and mega menu navigation refactor. All 11 features tested and verified working correctly.

features_tested.feature: PixelVue landing page at /pixelvue loads correctly with hero, stats, featured products, categories, applications, FAQs sections
features_tested.details: Page loads with data-testid='pixelvue-landing', hero with 'PixelVue' title, 'Illuminate Your Vision' tagline, stats (100K+, 3840Hz, 160°, 3 Yr), 3 featured products (iPoster, Unity, Creative Shapes), 3 categories (LED Poster, Commercial, Creative), 4 applications (Retail, Corporate, Events, Hospitality), FAQs section

features_tested.feature: iPoster detail page at /pixelvue/iposter loads with product info and specs
features_tested.details: Page loads with data-testid='iposter-page', hero with title, quick specs (40mm, 69kg, 16:9, 3840Hz), 6 features, applications list, specifications section, FAQs, CTA

features_tested.feature: Unity detail page at /pixelvue/unity loads with product info and specs
features_tested.details: Page loads with data-testid='unity-page', hero with title 'Flexibility Meets Performance', quick specs (1000×250mm, 90°, 15cm, 90%), 6 features, 5 shape configurations, specifications section, FAQs

features_tested.feature: Creative Shapes detail page at /pixelvue/creative-shapes loads with shape gallery and FAQs
features_tested.details: Page loads with data-testid='creative-shapes-page', hero with 'Transform Imagination Into Reality', quick specs (10+ yrs, ∞, 360°, 100%), 6 shape types (Circular/Spherical, Letter Shaped, Ring Display, LED Cube, Triangle Screen, Custom Shapes), FAQs

features_tested.feature: Navigation mega menu shows all 5 product families with correct colors (LumiMorph-cyan, NaturaTex-emerald, SignaTouch-amber, GlassMorph-violet, PixelVue-rose)
features_tested.details: All 5 product family links found in navbar with correct data-testid and color classes: nav-lumimorph (text-cyan), nav-naturatex (text-emerald), nav-signatouch (text-amber), nav-glassmorph (text-violet), nav-pixelvue (text-rose)

features_tested.feature: Hamburger/More menu contains secondary links: About Us, Blog, Contact Us, FAQ, Resources, Case Studies, Factory Tour, Distribution
features_tested.details: More menu (data-testid='nav-more-btn') opens dropdown with all 8 secondary links: nav-more-about, nav-more-blog, nav-more-contact, nav-more-faq, nav-more-resources, nav-more-case-studies, nav-more-factory-tour, nav-more-distribution

features_tested.feature: Case Studies is NOT visible as a direct link in the main header (moved to hamburger menu)
features_tested.details: Verified Case Studies is only accessible via the More dropdown menu, not as a direct header link

features_tested.feature: Product family links in navbar navigate to correct pages
features_tested.details: Tested navigation for all 5 product families: LumiMorph→/lumimorph, NaturaTex→/naturatex, SignaTouch→/signatouch, GlassMorph→/glassmorph, PixelVue→/pixelvue
Tools dropdown (data-testid='nav-tools-dropdown') opens on hover with specifier and contractor tools

features_tested.feature: Products, Solutions, Technologies dropdowns work correctly
features_tested.details: All three dropdowns open on hover: nav-products-dropdown, nav-solutions-dropdown, nav-tech-dropdown

features_tested.feature: Mobile navigation shows product families section
features_tested.details: Mobile menu (data-testid='mobile-menu') shows FEATURED PRODUCTS section with all 5 product families with correct colors, plus MORE section with all 8 secondary links

context_for_next_testing_agent: PixelVue product family has 4 pages: 1) Landing page at /pixelvue with featured products and categories, 2) iPoster at /pixelvue/iposter, 3) Unity at /pixelvue/unity, 4) Creative Shapes at /pixelvue/creative-shapes. Navigation mega menu now shows 5 direct product family links (LumiMorph, NaturaTex, SignaTouch, GlassMorph, PixelVue) with brand colors, and secondary links (About, Blog, Contact, FAQ, Resources, Case Studies, Factory Tour, Distribution) are in the hamburger/More menu. All pages use rose/pink accent colors for PixelVue.
